source.estimate: Estimated from the last reply and the model's window.

chat_insight.context_unknown: The window's size is not known yet. It shows after the first reply when the model's window is known.
chat_insight.breakdown_note: The agent's rough estimate per category; it need not add up to the total.
chat_insight.compress_wait: Wait for the reply to finish, then compress.
chat_insight.focus_placeholder: Focus (optional): what the summary should keep
chat_insight.focus_hint: The agent summarises the older part of the chat so the window has room again. With a focus it keeps that in view.
chat_insight.subagents_empty_hint: When the agent delegates part of the work, the subagents show here.
chat_insight.subagents_none: This agent does not say when it delegates.
chat_insight.steer_queued: Sent. It reads the note before its next step.
chat_insight.changes_empty_hint: Files a run changes in the chat's folder show here.
chat_insight.changes_truncated: More files changed than are kept; these are the first.
chat_insight.changes_incomplete: The folder was large: a change may be missing.
chat_insight.diff_live: The diff is ready when the run ends.
chat_insight.diff_binary: A binary file has no text diff.
chat_insight.diff_too_large: The diff is too large to show.
chat_insight.diff_unavailable: No copy of the file from before the run was kept.
chat_insight.files_empty_hint: Files the agent writes, the chat's folder and attachments show here.
chat_insight.files_truncated: The folder is large; not every file is listed.
